name: cloudflare-ddns-durable-last-known-good-eaa8
instr:
cloudflare-ddns cannot preserve last-known-good addresses across restarts when a provider temporarily fails. Build bounded, durable recovery without exposing persisted addresses in configuration output or letting stale observations override current configuration.

Every Provider must derive a stable recovery identity from canonical, family-relevant configuration, independent of detection results and process addresses. File may accept an unexpired match only after detection fails, preserving malformed-content diagnostics. Successful detection remains authoritative. Static always uses configured entries, including explicit-empty. Unavailable rejects recovery and invalidates that provider-family state permanently.

UpdateIPsWithRecovery may recover only after detection becomes unavailable and identity, family, prefix policy, age, and provider eligibility match. An empty recovered result remains unavailable and preserves stored success. Persist fresh results only after filtering succeeds; cancellation and unavailable detection cannot replace usable state.

Store a canonical, lossless, versioned, strictly decoded record of identity, family, default prefix length, observation time, availability, invalidation, and sorted raw entries. Replace complete state atomically, preserving the previous readable generation if interrupted. Omitted recovery performs no reads or writes and changes no parsing, configuration construction or output, or secret handling. Enabled RecoveryPolicy requires
